public_rationale: Independent research documented toxic generation, and PaLM's developers acknowledged the existing literature on language-model risks. That supports the ordinary reading that significant problems were already recognized by August 2022. It does not establish that every language-model application was unreliable or that embodiment necessarily worsened the risks.
limitations: Recognition is established within the research community, not through a survey of public awareness.
This assessment excludes the separate prediction about greater problems in robots.

our_interpretation: Assess the normalized observation about language models, excluding the separate prediction that embodiment would make their problems worse.
The plain reading is that significant limitations and risks were already documented and recognized in research, not that language models were useless.
Use the latest research reporting year to date, 2022-01-01 through 2022-08-18. Research has no standard quarterly reporting period; earlier publications provide background.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporary primary research documents significant language-model problems, with acknowledgment by the developers of PaLM or other evidence that these problems were recognized beyond an isolated example.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporary research establishes that the alleged problems were absent or already reliably resolved in the relevant language technology.
